unit_id_format.range_scope: a scope of several scenes is written first..last (U-05-SC01..SC05)

unit_order.steps_0_to_6: Steps 0 to 6 run in order, once each; checkpoint B sits between steps 5 and 6.

per_sequence: U-07 units for every scene of the sequence, in screen order (a big scene as -P1, -P2, -LIST)
checkpoint C: blocks for the first sequence only, unless the user said 'stop after each group'; later sequences report and carry on
U-08 units for every scene of the sequence, in screen order, batches in ID order
after each scene's last batch: ID-07 and COVER-02 to COVER-04 in full, and TIME-03
steps_7_and_8.previous_shot: In a handout, the previous scene's last shot is a finished SHOT for scenes in an earlier sequence, and a list item for an earlier scene of the same sequence.
steps_7_and_8.quick_depth: At quick depth step 8 does not run: each sequence is its U-07 units and checkpoint C.
steps_7_and_8.chat: A chat holds one sequence; at its end the resume line names the check chat (7.4).

order: (every other batch of SC01 to SC05, in order)
(every other batch of SC07 to SC10)
(every other batch of SC11 to SC13)

unit_order.steps_9_to_11: After the last sequence in scope, in order.
unit_order.add_ons: On request, after step 11: A (12) storyboards, B (13) grey previews (Claude Code only), C (14) generation packs, D (15) edit and finishing. Nothing else depends on them.
unit_order.resume: Step 16 is not a stage of the work: it runs whenever the user resumes or something goes wrong, and hands back to the next unit.

card_part_rules.naming: A card part is written {card, part}. 'whole' loads the whole file. Cards R05 and R07 are the reference files 05 and 07.
card_part_rules.headings: Every part except 'whole' is a ## heading in its card with exactly the heading text given here; the part runs to the next ## heading. Card writers (WP11) write each listed heading; a department card may also have ## headings for its nine anatomy parts (6.4), read when the card is loaded whole.
card_part_rules.situation_cards: Situation cards (15-20) always have the ## headings 'Questions in order' and 'Traps'; steps 7 and 8 load only those two.
card_part_rules.cap: At most card_tokens_per_unit_max card tokens per unit (limits.json).
merge_order: the depth's base list (quick, or standard for step 8)
situation parts for the scene's tags, in tag order
card_part_rules.drop_rule: make_handout.py drops the lowest-listed parts first when the cap is reached.
card_part_rules.depth_lists: quick, standard and detailed lists are cumulative: standard = quick + standard_adds; detailed = standard + detailed_adds. all_depths applies at every depth; when_* lists apply when their condition holds.
card_part_rules.target_words: target_words is a guide for card writers so a unit's parts fit the cap; about 1.4 tokens per word (limits.json).
